title: PACKABUNCHAS
author: Mattia Fortunati
license_scope: The pinned PACKABUNCHAS source repository and original MIT license are retained. Its embedded Stack Exchange code excerpts carry separate CC BY-SA 3.0 or 4.0 terms and are attributed in the third-party notices. A linear interpolation helper that linked to an unverifiable CodePen Pen was replaced with an equivalent local expression and the link was removed. Generated ZzFX and ZzFXM audio code is MIT-licensed and credited by upstream. No upstream screenshot or remote asset is bundled.
source_adaptations: Replaced the CodePen-linked lerp helper with the equivalent local expression start + (end - start) * amt and removed the external URL because the specific Pen's license could not be verified. The original upstream game.js SHA-256 is retained in upstream_source_hashes; the adapted file SHA-256 is in vendored_source_hashes.
host_adaptations: Runs in an allow-scripts-only opaque-origin iframe with a no-network content security policy.
Replaces localStorage calls with a bounded allowlisted parent save bridge.
Freezes animation frames, timers and background music while paused.
Uses the upstream portrait canvas and touch/mouse controls; the original English game UI is retained.
